sources.entry: Sonora - Minimal, beautifully designed music player for macOS.

summary.one_liner: Sonora is an open-source, minimal music player for macOS (Sonora 2.0 source) built with Objective-C and Cocoa, previously sold on the Mac App Store.
summary.what_it_does: Sonora is a music player for the Mac with a grid-based album view showing artwork, built largely on Core Animation. It supports many audio formats through SFBAudioEngine. It offers instant search across albums, artists, songs, and mixes, plus a global search window with a customizable hotkey to play and enqueue music. Playback runs through a central queue where songs can be added, removed, and reordered, and the queue can be saved as a mix. It includes built-in Last.fm scrobbling and sharing to Twitter, iMessage, and Email. The README says the code is for Sonora 2.0 and that the Sonora 1.0 App Store version is available separately.
use_cases: play local music library on a Mac
build and save a play queue or mix
study or modify a Cocoa music player app
how_to_run: pod repo add Sonora-Podspecs git://github.com/sonoramac/Podspecs.git master
cd into the Sonora folder and run: pod install
Download the SFBAudioEngine Frameworks archive and place the Frameworks folder inside Sonora/External/SFBAudioEngine/
Fill in extra information per SNRConstants.m, then open Sonora.xcworkspace (not the xcodeproj) and compile
notable: Album grid view with artwork, built largely on Core Animation
Global search window with customizable hotkey
Central queue that can be saved as a mix
Source code under BSD 3-Clause; design assets not licensed for use
caveats: README says the app is functional but has many bugs, and much old code remains
Build requires CocoaPods, mogenerator, extra framework downloads, and manual constants setup
Design assets (Resources folder) cannot be used, and redistribution of the app is prohibited
Sonora 1.0 and 2.0 share a bundle identifier, so the old preferences file must be deleted before running 2.0
summary.license: BSD 3-Clause (code only; assets not licensed for any use)
